title: Aye mere baradaar
body:
Zainab(sa) Ne Kaha Parcham-e-Ghazi(as) Se Lipatkar
Ay Mere Baraadar
Kuch Der Mein Sar Se Mere Chin Jayegi Chaadar
Ay Mere Baraadar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Batlao Pharaire Pa Laga Khoon Hai Kis Ka
Dil Rota Hai Mera
Thamay Hue Aaye Hain Kamar Khaime Mein Sarwar(as)
Ay Mere Baraadar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tum Sogaye Khaimon Mein Bhi Ab Aag Lagegi
Masnad Bhi Jalegi
Chhin Jaye Ga Ab Syed-e-Sajjad(as) Ka Bistar
Ay Mere Baraadar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kooza Liye Hatho'n Mein Ye Kehti Hai Sakina(sa)
Dushwar Hai Jeena
Taskeen Doo'n Kya Kehke Usey Bolo Mein Aakhir
Ay Mere Baraadar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ghar Mein Hain Sabhi Teen Shab-o-Roz Ke Pyase
De Kaun Dila Se
Gahware Mein Bechain Bohat Hain Ali Asghar(as)
Ay Mere Baraadar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Badh Badh Ke Sitamgaron Ne Tum Par Kiye Hamlay
Shane Bhi Nahi'n Thay
Is Haal Mein Tum Aaye Ho Ghoray Se Zameen Par
Ay Mere Baraadar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jalti Hui Reti Pe Pade Hain Shah-e-Abrar(as)
Be Yaar-o-Madadgar
Badhta Hai Laeen Haath Mein Thamay Hue Khanjar
Ay Mere Baraadar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Behno'n Ka Teri Ab To Hai Allah Nigehbaa'n
Hoti Hain Pareshaa'n
Lootai'n Ge Sitamgaar Humein Khaime Jalakar
Ay Mere Baraadar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Is Gham Se Bura Haal Hua Jata Hai Mera
Dil Rota Hai Mera
Darbar Mein Haakim Ke Khari Hai Teri Khwahar
Ay Mere Baraadar
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Kya Bainiya Nouha Kaha Sajjad Nazar Ne
Hasnain Se Sun Ke
Ro Ro Ke Yehi Kehti Rahi Zainab-e-Muztar(sa)
Ay Mere Baraadar
